title: Camelot Authority Epoch
description: v1.2 multidimensional authority vector and cluster fencing epoch state. Formalizes A_epoch = <E_leadership, R_policy, R_revocation, R_registry, R_identity, R_contract> ensuring granular distributed invalidation across VPS, Excalibur, and local workstation.

authority_vector.description: 6-dimensional authority vector tuple: [E_leadership, R_policy, R_revocation, R_registry, R_identity, R_contract].

fenced_leader_node.description: Node ID of the previous leader fenced out by this epoch change.

active_leader_node.description: Node ID of the active leader recognized in this epoch.

policy_bundle_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the currently authoritative Sentinel policy bundle.

contracts_lock_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of CONTRACTS.lock governing this epoch.
